cases.title: 台北淡水河畔的温柔女友VLOG
cases.imageAlt: 台北淡水河畔的温柔女友VLOG
cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
【Style】Ultimate Girlfriend POV, handheld selfie VLOG, vertical screen (9:16), film grain filter, natural light (sunset golden hour), natural camera shake and adjustment.
【Duration】15 seconds
【Protagonist】Taiwanese girl, long hair slightly curly, wearing a gentle knitted cardigan, clear makeup, speaking tone soft and glutinous, with a bit of coquetry and complaining accent (Taiwanese accent).
【Scene】Tamsui River bank in Taipei, background is golden sunset, sparkling river surface, and the Lover's Bridge in the distance.

[00:00-00:05] Shot 1: The Rushed Intro.
Visuals: The camera shakes quite a bit because she is walking fast. She walks while looking back at the camera (at you), eyebrows slightly furrowed, pretending to be angry.
Action: One hand holding the phone, the other hand pressing down hair messed up by the wind.
【Dialogue/Lip-sync】(Soft complaining tone): "Hey, walk faster! The sun is about to set! It's all because you're dragging your feet, if we can't take good photos later I'm going to be mad!"

[00:00-00:10] Shot 2: Sharing the View.
Visuals: She stops walking, moves the lens away from her face, turning towards the stunning golden sunset (Golden Hour) across the river.
Action: The camera shows the scenery for 2 seconds, then immediately turns back to focus on her face. Her face is illuminated golden by the sunset, revealing a super happy smile, eyes squinted into slits.
【Dialogue/Lip-sync】(Amazed tone): "Wow~ look quickly! Isn't it super beautiful! This light is absolutely amazing, it looks good no matter how you snap it!"

[00:10-00:15] Shot 3: The Interaction.
Visuals: An extra tall Tamsui-specific soft serve ice cream suddenly appears in her hand.
Action: She first raises the ice cream in front of the lens (feeding you), then quickly licks it herself, with a little ice cream accidentally getting on the tip of her nose. She giggles at the camera.
【Dialogue/Lip-sync】(Playful tone): "Here, the first bite is for you. Hurry up, it's going to melt! Hehe, today's date counts as a pass!"

中文提示词:
【风格】极致第一人称女友视角(Ultimate Girlfriend POV)，手持自拍VLOG，竖屏(9:16)，胶片感滤镜(Film Grain)，自然光(夕阳黄金时刻)，镜头有自然的晃动和调整。
【时长】15秒
【主角】台湾女生，长发微卷，穿着温柔的针织开衫，妆容清透，说话语气软糯、带点撒娇和抱怨的口音(台湾腔)。
【场景】台北淡水河岸边，背景是金色的夕阳、波光粼粼的河面和远处的情人桥。

[00:00-00:05] 镜头1：赶路与抱怨(The Rushed Intro)。
画面：镜头晃动得比较厉害，因为她在快走。她一边走一边回头看镜头（看你），眉头微皱，假装生气。
动作：一只手举着手机，另一只手还要压住被风吹乱的头发。
【台词/口型】（软糯抱怨音）：“欸你走快一点啦！太阳快要下山了捏！都是你拖拖拉拉的，等一下拍不到好看的照片我要生气喔！”

[00:00-00:10] 镜头2：绝美景色分享(Sharing the View)。
画面：她停下脚步，把镜头从自己脸上移开，转向河对岸绝美的金色夕阳（Golden Hour）。
动作：镜头展示了2秒景色，然后马上又转回对准她的脸。她的脸被夕阳照得金灿灿的，露出超级开心的笑容，眼睛眯成一条缝。
【台词/口型】（惊叹音）：“哇～你快看！有没有超美！这个光线真的绝了，随便拍都好看！”

[00:10-00:15] 镜头3：互动与结尾(The Interaction)。
画面：她手里突然多了一支淡水特有的超高霜淇淋。
动作：她先把霜淇淋举到镜头前（喂你），然后自己快速舔了一口，鼻尖不小心沾到一点冰淇淋。她对着镜头傻笑。
【台词/口型】（调皮音）：“呐，第一口先给你吃。快点，要融化了啦！嘻嘻，今天的约会算你及格！”

英文提示词:
Create a battle scene using the three characters and setting from the image [Scene Setting] Ruins of a Gothic cathedral, crumbling stone pillars, twilight filtering through broken stained glass windows, dust floating. Seconds 0-3: Female warrior advances holding a spear, camera follows pushing forward from behind. Suddenly, a black dragon pounces from the shadows, claws tearing through the stone floor, debris exploding. Female warrior rolls to dodge, spear tracing an arc of light. Camera shakes violently, dragon roar shakes the cathedral. Seconds 4-6: Black-armored warrior rushes in, shield slams into the side of the dragon's head, a dull thud of metal hitting bone. Dragon head knocked to the side, sharp teeth flinging saliva. Quick cut to female warrior, she takes the opportunity to leap up, spear tip stabbing straight into the gap between the dragon's neck scales, sparks flying. Camera follows the moment of the spear tip impact. Seconds 7-9: Black dragon furiously sweeps its tail, tail blade cutting off a stone pillar. Pillar collapses with a crash, smashing towards the two warriors. Black-armored warrior raises shield to hard block, shield surface dents, feet plowing deep marks on the ground. Female warrior slides low through the rain of debris, spear rubbing against the ground creating sparks. Dragon wings spread blocking the light, cathedral falls into shadow. Seconds 10-12: Female warrior fiercely stabs the dragon's belly, spear body sinking deep. Black dragon painfully raises head roaring, neck expanding, throat glowing red. Black-armored warrior senses danger, sprints and tackles the female warrior rolling backwards. The next moment, dragon fire gushes out, pillar of fire swallowing the spot they were just in, stone slabs melting into magma. Camera distorts in the heatwave. Seconds 13-15: Two warriors execute the finisher simultaneously. Black-armored warrior strikes the dragon's neck joint from the flank with shield, female warrior throws the spear with full force from the front, spear body rotating and piercing through the dragon's throat. Black dragon's body stiffens, crashes heavily to the ground, raising dust filling the sky. Camera pulls back and freezes: Two warriors stand panting, giant dragon lying dead in the center of the cathedral, twilight from broken stained glass windows illuminating the battlefield ruins. Quick fade to black. [Style Instructions] • Fast-paced editing, no slow motion • Camera shakes violently upon impact, dust bursting • Close-up shots capturing the moment of weapon and armor collision • Maintain a dark Gothic atmosphere throughout, interweaving firelight and twilight • Sound effects: Metal collision, dragon roar, pillar collapse, flame howling [Camera Movement] Follow push-in → Shaking close-up → Pan sweep → Heatwave distortion → Pull back freeze frame

英文提示词:
【风格】New Chinese Wuxia (Neo-Chinese Wuxia), Ink Fluid Simulation Particle Effects, Ultra-high-speed Cinematography, Live-action combined with CG, Black, White and Red Visual Impact, Extremely Fast Pacing. 【时长】15秒 【角色】 Black Ink Warrior: Movements are vigorous and forceful, every strike is as heavy as splashed ink landscape painting. Red Assassin: Movements are light and eerie, as sharp as vermilion dots on lacquer. 【场景】A pure white void space, the ground is covered with Xuan paper (rice paper). [00:00-00:05] 镜头1：静极思动。 From extreme stillness to extreme motion. The image initially is a static black and white ink painting, two ink dots confronting each other. Suddenly, the sound of Guqin explodes. 【动作】Two ink dots instantly transform into afterimages of real people rushing towards each other. The person in black throws a heavy punch, instantly exploding a thick ball of black ink in the air (replacing smoke/dust), the ink solidifies in the air into vigorous calligraphy strokes. The person in red dodges sideways, the dagger in hand carving a bright vermilion red line. [00:05-00:10] 镜头2：狂草对决。 Ultra-high-speed rapid cuts. The two engage in dazzling close-quarters combat (action choreography level). 【视觉奇观】Every physical collision (fists and feet), the sound is not of flesh, but of ink splashing explosions. The black-clad person's sweep leg brings up a black ink wave tsunami; the red-clad person's aerial chain kicks leave red afterimage trails in the air. The Xuan paper on the ground is torn by their footsteps, ink smudges spread. [00:10-00:15] 镜头3：破壁一击。 Slow motion over-cranked. Both use their ultimate moves to collide simultaneously. The black ink dragon fist and the red vermilion bird blade deadlock in the air. 【高能时刻】Huge energy causes the entire 2D ink world to collapse. The camera pulls back sharply, discovering they actually broke the "dimensional wall", "falling" from a torn ink painting hanging on the wall onto the wooden floor of the real world, surrounded by lingering ink atmosphere and paper scraps, the two maintain their final fighting pose, panting in freeze frame.

【风格】新国风武侠（Neo-Chinese Wuxia），水墨流体粒子特效（Ink Fluid Simulation），超高速摄影（High-speed Cinematography），真人实拍与CG结合，黑白红三色视觉冲击，节奏极快。 【时长】15秒 【角色】 黑衣墨客（Black Ink Warrior）：动作刚猛，每一击都如泼墨山水般沉重。 红衣刺客（Red Assassin）：动作轻灵诡异，如朱砂点漆般锐利。 【场景】一个纯白的虚无空间，地面铺满宣纸。 [00:00-00:05] 镜头1：静极思动（The Awakening）。 极静到极动。画面最初是一幅静止的黑白水墨画，两个墨点对峙。突然，古琴声炸裂。 【动作】两个墨点瞬间化为真人的残影冲向对方。黑衣人一记重拳轰出，空气中瞬间炸开一团浓重的黑色墨汁（代替烟尘），墨汁在空中凝固成刚劲的书法笔触。红衣人侧身闪避，手中匕首划出一道鲜艳的朱砂红线。 [00:05-00:10] 镜头2：狂草对决（Ink Combat Choreography）。 超高速快剪（Rapid Cuts）。两人展开令人眼花缭乱的近身格斗（武术指导级动作）。 【视觉奇观】每一次肢体碰撞（拳脚相加），都不是肉体的声音，而是墨汁飞溅的爆炸声。黑衣人的扫堂腿带起一片黑色的墨浪海啸；红衣人的腾空连环踢在空中留下红色的残影轨迹。地面上的宣纸被他们的步伐撕裂，墨迹晕染。 [00:10-00:15] 镜头3：破壁一击（Breaking the Dimension）。 慢动作升格。两人同时使出绝招对撞。黑色的墨龙拳与红色的朱雀刃在空中死死抵住。 【高能时刻】巨大的能量让整个二维的水墨世界崩塌。镜头猛地拉远，发现他们竟然打破了“次元壁”，从一幅挂在墙上被撕裂的水墨画中“跌落”到了现实世界的木地板上，周围环绕着尚未散去的墨韵和纸屑，两人保持着最后的格斗姿态定格喘息。

cases.title: 拥有自我意识的镜子倒影
cases.imageAlt: 拥有自我意识的镜子倒影
cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
【Style】Pseudo-documentary (Vlog Style), Hyperrealism, Fixed camera shot feel, Natural light, With a touch of suspenseful comedy color. 【Duration】15 seconds 【Protagonist】An ordinary young beautiful woman, in front of her own bathroom sink. [00:00-00:06] Shot 1: Normalcy (Normalcy). Scene: In front of an ordinary large bathroom mirror. Action: The protagonist is brushing her teeth facing the mirror, mouth full of foam. She makes various funny grimaces at the mirror while brushing (winking and blinking). Key Detail: At this time, the reflection in the mirror is completely normal, actions synchronized. [00:06-00:11] Shot 2: The Glitch (The Glitch). Action: The protagonist finishes brushing teeth, lowers head to spit out foam, then turns around to leave the bathroom. Highlight Moment (Core Climax): Just as the protagonist's real body has turned and left the mirror's frame, that "reflection" in the mirror actually **did not move**! That "reflection" still maintains the teeth-brushing posture, and even smirks and raises an eyebrow at the camera, staying for a full 2 seconds, before suddenly panicking and "fast-forwarding" to catch up with the body's action and disappear. Director's Note: Must create an extremely realistic "network lag" feel, giving the reflection a sense of independent consciousness. [00:11-00:15] Shot 3: The Punchline (The Punchline). Action: The protagonist, having walked to the doorway, seems to feel something is wrong, and suddenly turns back to look at the mirror. Result: The mirror has completely returned to normal at this time, empty, only reflecting the opposite wall. The protagonist scratches her head in confusion, revealing an expression of doubting life to the camera. The image freezes on the protagonist's confused face (comedy effect).

【Style】Douyin live streaming sales style, extremely fast speaking speed (Rap-like Speed), extremely excited emotions.
【Duration】15 seconds
【Protagonist】Passionate sales anchor (influencer beauty), with mobile phones and tablets in front of her, background is a messy but authentic high-end live streaming studio.

[00:00-00:05] Shot 1: The Hook.
Scene: Split screen display. Left side is blurry distorted PPT-style AI video (with a big red cross marked on it), right side is cinematic quality Seedance generated video.
Action: The anchor slaps the table hard, gets her face close to the lens, with a look of heartbreak.
【Extremely fast speaking speed/Rap-like feeling】："Stop using those trash models promoted all over the internet! Can you watch the generated videos with crooked faces? Fam, today I've brought down the price of Seedance 2.0 for you!"

[00:05-00:10] Shot 2: The Demo.
Scene: Close-up of phone screen. Anchor inputs: "Cyberpunk rainy night, girl looking back". Presses generate button, progress bar fills instantly (0.5s).
Special Effects: Instantly explodes (particle light and shadow pops up) a 4K, 60fps, hair-details-visible stunning video on the screen.
Action: Anchor points at the screen tapping crazily, spraying saliva.
【Extremely fast speaking speed】："Look at this speed! Look at this lighting and shadow! No graphics card needed, no queuing! This is Seedance 2.0! Hollywood directors are using it!"

[00:10-00:15] Shot 3: The Call to Action.
Scene: A huge countdown appears behind the anchor (only 3 seconds left), frantically flashing "Free Trial" yellow shopping cart icon appears at the bottom of the screen.
Action: Anchor puts hands together begging, then points frantically at the bottom of the screen.
【Extremely fast speaking speed】："Global debut! Free trial for the first 100 only! The link is in the bottom left! Too slow and it's gone! Go for it! 3, 2, 1, put up the link!"

Action: He takes a deep breath, and the surrounding air instantly freezes. As he draws his sword out of the sheath, a huge blue water dragon condensed from high-pressure water flow appears out of thin air, circling his body and blade at high speed, making the roar of flowing water.
Special Effect Details: The water flow has a realistic splash feeling, illuminating the dark forest.

[00:05-00:10] Shot 2: Thunderclap Flash · Advance (Extreme Speed feeling)
Screen: The opponent on the opposite side, a blond swordsman wearing a yellow triangle pattern haori, lowers his body extremely low, making an Iaijutsu (drawing sword technique) pose.

[Storyboard Sequence & Dialogue]
Shot 1: Medium Shot.
Visual Content: The male lead stands in a dimly lit office, holding a stack of reports, frowning tightly, looking very stressed. The surrounding air is also gray and hazy.
Subtitle/Dialogue: "This project is too hard, who can save me..."

Shot 2: Close-up to Panoramic Shot.
Visual Content: A beam of warm light suddenly shines next to the male lead. The camera tilts up to reveal the female lead's extremely tall figure. She appears out of thin air, as if walking out of a comic, with a brilliant smile.
Subtitle/Dialogue: "Heard someone is making a wish?"

Shot 3: Two-shot Medium Shot, height difference interaction.
Visual Content: The male lead looks up in surprise (must reflect this cute look of looking up). The female lead bends slightly, pointing her finger gently at the documents in the male lead's hand.
Visual Effects: Where the fingertips touch, golden magic particles explode.

Shot 4: Scene Transformation (Fantasy Moment).
Visual Content: As the golden particles spread, the originally dull office background instantly disappears, turning into a magnificent aurora and sea of clouds. The male lead's suit becomes brand new and crisp, and his expression changes from anxiety to surprise.
Subtitle/Dialogue: "From now on, I've got your luck covered."

Shot 5: Close-up, Eye Contact.
Visual Content: The two look at each other against the background of the sea of clouds. The female lead winks playfully, and the male lead scratches his head shyly.
Atmosphere: The screen is filled with pink and golden bubbles, extremely aesthetic.

Shot 6: Freeze Frame Ending.
Visual Content: The backs of the two people standing side by side, in front of them is the dazzling night view of the future city.
Subtitle Effect: Large text displaying "Good Luck Descends".

字幕/对白：“这项目太难了，谁能来救救我...”

字幕/对白：“以后，你的运气我包了。”

镜头6：定格结尾。

画面内容：两人并肩站立的背影，面前是璀璨的未来都市夜景。

字幕特效：大字显示《好运降临》。
